solutions.hd8: WITH consultation_departments AS (SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, c.consultation_date, c.id AS consultation_id, s.name AS department, LAG(s.name) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id) AS previous_department FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id JOIN departments s ON s.id = m.department_id) SELECT first_name, last_name, consultation_date, department, previous_department FROM consultation_departments WHERE previous_department IS NOT NULL AND department <> previous_department ORDER BY last_name, first_name, consultation_date, consultation_id;

textes.Bienvenue à l’hôpital universitaire des: Welcome to the Quatre-Vents University Hospital. Patients, doctors, departments, consultations, hospital stays and prescriptions: the data of its six departments is all here. You help its team: Agnès at admissions, Yasmine at the front office, Lionel at the pharmacy, Dr. Hamon on coordination and Bertrand, the director. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par service de l’hôpital, avec: One row per hospital department, with its floor and its number of beds. Doctors, nurses and hospital stays are linked to a department.
textes.Une ligne par médecin : son identité, sa: One row per doctor: their name, their specialty, their hire date and the department they belong to (one department per doctor).
textes.Une ligne par infirmier ou infirmière, a: One row per nurse, with their department and their hire date. Nursing staff aren’t linked to consultations or hospital stays.
textes.Une ligne par patient enregistré à l’hôp: One row per patient registered at the hospital, whether or not they’ve had a consultation yet: their name, their date of birth, their sex, their city and their registration date.
textes.Une ligne par consultation : un patient: One row per consultation: a patient seen by a doctor on a given date, with the duration and the diagnosis. A consultation’s department is that of the doctor seen.
textes.Une ligne par séjour d’un patient dans u: One row per stay of a patient in a department, with the doctor in charge, the bed and the admission and discharge dates. A stay without a discharge date is ongoing; a patient can have several stays.
textes.Une ligne par médicament prescrit lors d: One row per medication prescribed during a consultation, with its dosage and the length of the treatment. A consultation can have several prescriptions, or none.
textes.Nom du service : « Cardiologie », « Pédi: Name of the department: “Cardiology”, “Pediatrics”, “General surgery”, “Neurology”, “Oncology” or “Emergency”.
textes.Étage du service, de 0 (rez-de-chaussée): Floor of the department, from 0 (ground floor) to 5; each department has its own floor.
textes.Nombre de lits du service, c’est-à-dire: Number of beds in the department, meaning the number of patients it can admit at the same time.
textes.Spécialité du médecin, qui correspond à: Specialty of the doctor, which matches their department: “Cardiologist”, “Pediatrician”, “Surgeon”, “Neurologist”, “Oncologist” or “Emergency physician”.
textes.Date d’embauche à l’hôpital, au format A: Date hired at the hospital, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Le service auquel le médecin est rattach: The department the doctor belongs to.
textes.Le service où travaille l’infirmier ou l: The department where the nurse works.
Date of birth, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Date d’enregistrement du patient à l’hôp: Date the patient was registered at the hospital (YYYY-MM-DD), not to be confused with being admitted for a stay.
textes.Le médecin consulté ; son service est ce: The doctor seen; their department is the consultation’s department.
textes.Date de la consultation, au format AAAA-: Date of the consultation, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Duration of the consultation, in minutes.
textes.Diagnostic posé (ex. « Hypertension », «: Diagnosis made (e.g. “Hypertension”, “Ear infection”); empty (NULL) if it hasn’t been made yet.
textes.Identifiant unique de l’hospitalisation: Unique ID of the hospital stay.
textes.Le service qui accueille le patient pend: The department that takes care of the patient during the stay.
textes.Le médecin responsable du séjour, qui ap: The doctor in charge of the stay, who belongs to the department taking care of the patient.
textes.Date d’entrée du patient, au format AAAA: Admission date of the patient, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Date de sortie (AAAA-MM-JJ) ; vide (NULL: Discharge date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty (NULL) as long as the patient is still in hospital.
textes.Code du lit occupé, qui commence par les: Code of the bed occupied, which starts with the department’s letters (e.g. “C101” in Cardiology, “CH301” in General surgery).
textes.La consultation pendant laquelle le médi: The consultation during which the medication was prescribed.
textes.Dosage en texte, avec son unité (ex. « 5: Dosage as text, with its unit (e.g. “500 mg”, “1 g”); decimals are written with a point (“2.5 mg”).
Length of the treatment, in days.
textes.Quels patients sont encore hospitalisés: Which patients are still in hospital?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. Each stay of a patient in a department is recorded with its admission date, then its discharge date when they go home; as long as the discharge isn’t recorded, the cell stays empty and the stay is ongoing. Agnès, a manager at the admissions office, is reviewing the occupied beds this morning. For each ongoing stay, she wants to know who is in hospital and since when.
textes.la date d’entrée du séjour: the admission date of the stay
textes.les séjours en cours, c’est-à-dire sans: the ongoing stays, meaning those without a discharge date
textes.Un séjour en cours se reconnaît à sa dat: An ongoing stay is one whose discharge date is empty. To show the name, link each stay to its patient. The admission date is the stay’s, not the date the patient was registered at the hospital.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each registered patient has a file with their name, their date of birth and the city where they live. Ophélie works at the reception desk, where patients are registered when they arrive. She wants to send an information letter to those who live in Paris. To avoid any mailing mistake, she’ll check each name against the date of birth.
textes.par nom, puis par prénom: by last name, then by first name
textes.La ville fait partie du dossier du patie: The city is part of the patient’s file: a single condition is enough, with the exact text “Paris”, capital letter included.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each consultation is recorded with its date, its duration in minutes and the doctor’s diagnosis. When the diagnosis hasn’t been entered yet, its cell stays empty. Yasmine, a medical secretary, keeps these files up to date. She follows up with the doctors whose consultations are still waiting for a diagnosis, starting with the oldest ones.
textes.les consultations sans diagnostic, c’est: the consultations without a diagnosis, meaning those whose diagnosis cell is empty (NULL)
textes.Un diagnostic manquant est une case vide: A missing diagnosis is an empty cell, with no value at all: you can’t compare it with an equals sign. There’s a separate way to ask whether a cell is empty.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments, such as Cardiology or Pediatrics. Each doctor belongs to a single department, but the department’s name isn’t written with the doctor: it’s stored separately, with the list of departments. Yasmine, a medical secretary, is updating the Cardiology department’s directory. She wants the list of its doctors, with their specialty and their hire date.
textes.les médecins rattachés au service « Card: the doctors who belong to the “Cardiology” department
textes.Le médecin ne connaît son service que pa: A doctor only knows their department by an ID. Link each doctor to their department to read its name, then keep only Cardiology.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each stay of a patient starts on its admission date and ends when they go home: its discharge date is then recorded. Until it is, the stay is ongoing. Agnès, a manager at the admissions office, is archiving the finished stays. For each one, she wants the patient’s name and the admission and discharge dates.
textes.les séjours terminés, c’est-à-dire qui o: the finished stays, meaning those that have a discharge date
textes.Un séjour terminé a une date de sortie r: A finished stay has a filled-in discharge date. Keep these stays, then link each one to its patient to show their name.
textes.Quels patients n’ont jamais consulté ?: Which patients have never had a consultation?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. A patient can be registered at the hospital without having been seen in consultation yet; consultations are stored separately, each with its patient. Ophélie, at the reception desk, wants to call these patients who have never been seen to offer them a first appointment. She also notes their city, to offer a time slot that suits their journey.
textes.les patients qui n’ont aucune consultati: the patients who have no consultation
textes.Pars de tous les patients et cherche leu: Start from every patient and look for their consultations. Also keep the ones for whom nothing is found, then keep only those.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. During a consultation, the doctor can prescribe one or more medications; each is recorded with its dosage (“500 mg”, “1 g”…) and the length of the treatment, in days. Lionel, the pharmacist, checks these prescriptions before handing out the medication. He’s reviewing the prescriptions of Amoxicillin, an antibiotic, to check the dosage and length of each treatment.
textes.la durée du traitement, en jours: the length of the treatment, in days
textes.par durée du traitement, de la plus long: by length of the treatment, longest first, then by prescription ID
textes.Une seule condition sur le nom du médica: A single condition on the name of the medication is enough. Then sort the treatments from the longest to the shortest.
textes.Quels patients sont nés après le 1er jan: Which patients were born after January 1, 2000?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Its patients are of all ages, from children born in 2019 to people born in the 1940s; their date of birth is written year-month-day. Yasmine, a medical secretary, is preparing a prevention campaign for the youngest, from children to young adults: those born after January 1, 2000, that day excluded.
textes.les patients nés après le 1er janvier 20: the patients born after January 1, 2000, that day excluded
textes.Écrites année-mois-jour, les dates se co: Written year-month-day, dates compare like text. “After” means strictly later: January 1, 2000 itself must not come out.
textes.Quelles consultations ont duré plus de 4: Which consultations lasted more than 40 minutes?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each consultation is recorded with the doctor who held it and its duration, from 15 to 50 minutes depending on the case. Dr. Hamon coordinates how consultations are organized. She’s studying the appointments longer than 40 minutes, without those of exactly 40 minutes, to find out which doctors hold them and organize their schedules better.
textes.le prénom du médecin consulté: the first name of the doctor seen
textes.les consultations de plus de 40 minutes,: the consultations longer than 40 minutes, without those of exactly 40 minutes
textes.par durée, de la plus longue à la plus c: by duration, longest first, then by consultation ID
textes.Relie chaque consultation à son médecin: Link each consultation to its doctor to show their name. “More than 40” means strictly above: exactly 40 minutes doesn’t count.
textes.Quelles consultations ont eu lieu en Neu: Which consultations took place in Neurology?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. A consultation isn’t recorded with a department: it belongs to the department of the doctor who sees the patient. Yasmine, a medical secretary, is preparing the Neurology department’s team meeting. The head of department wants to review the patients that its doctors saw in consultation: on what date, and with which doctor.
textes.le nom de famille du médecin consulté, s: the last name of the doctor seen, without their first name
textes.les consultations du service « Neurologi: the consultations of the “Neurology” department, meaning those held by a doctor of that department
textes.Pour savoir dans quel service a eu lieu: To find out which department a consultation took place in, go through its doctor, then through that doctor’s department. Also link the patient to show their name.
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Fourteen doctors see patients in consultation there, some much more often than others, and a few haven’t held any yet. For his fall review, Bertrand, the director, is comparing their activity: he wants the number of consultations of each doctor, from the busiest to those who haven’t seen anyone, with 0.
textes.son nombre de consultations, 0 s’il n’en: their number of consultations, 0 if they have none
textes.tous les médecins, y compris ceux qui n’: every doctor, including those with no consultation
textes.par nombre de consultations, du plus gra: by number of consultations, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Pars de tous les médecins, même ceux san: Start from every doctor, even those without a consultation, then count their consultations. Counting the rows would give 1 to a doctor without a consultation: count the consultations actually found instead.
textes.Quelle est la durée moyenne d’un séjour: What is the average length of a stay per department?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. Each stay takes place in a department, from the patient’s admission date to their discharge date, when it’s known; a stay without a discharge date is still ongoing. Agnès, a manager at the admissions office, wants to better predict when beds will free up. She compares the average length of the finished stays from one department to another, in days.
textes.la durée moyenne de ses séjours terminés: the average length of its finished stays, in days, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les séjours terminés, c’est-à-: only the finished stays, meaning those that have a discharge date
textes.seulement les services qui ont au moins: only the departments with at least one finished stay
textes.La durée d’un séjour est sa date de sort: The length of a stay is its discharge date minus its admission date, in days: a stay from September 5 to 10 lasts 5 days.
textes.Ne garde que les séjours terminés. La du: Keep only the finished stays. The length of a stay is the gap in days between its discharge and its admission: you need to turn each date into a number of days to do the subtraction. Then take the average department by department.
textes.Quels patients ont eu plusieurs consulta: Which patients have had several consultations?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. The same patient sometimes comes back several times for a consultation, and each appointment is recorded with its duration, in minutes. Yasmine, a medical secretary, is scheduling the next appointments. She’s finding the patients who came at least 2 times, with their number of consultations and the total medical time they represent.
textes.la durée totale de ses consultations : l: the total duration of their consultations: the sum of their durations, in minutes
textes.seulement les patients qui ont au moins: only the patients with at least 2 consultations
textes.par nombre de consultations, du plus gra: by number of consultations, largest first, then by total duration, longest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Pour chaque patient, compte ses consulta: For each patient, count their consultations and add up their durations. The threshold of 2 applies to the count: it can only be checked once the count is done.
textes.Combien de médecins compte chaque servic: How many doctors does each department have?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments, from Emergency to Oncology. Each doctor belongs to a single department, and a department may not have any doctor yet. Before starting his hiring, Bertrand, the director, is reviewing the staff: he wants the number of doctors in each department, 0 for a department that has none.
textes.son nombre de médecins, 0 s’il n’en a au: its number of doctors, 0 if it has none
textes.tous les services, y compris ceux qui n’: every department, including those with no doctor
textes.par nombre de médecins, du plus grand au: by number of doctors, largest first, then by department name
textes.Pars de tous les services, même ceux san: Start from every department, even those without a doctor, then count their doctors. Counting the rows would give 1 to an empty department: count the doctors actually found instead.
textes.Quels sont les 5 médicaments les plus pr: What are the 5 most prescribed medications?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. During their consultations, doctors prescribe medications, each with a dosage and a treatment length in days; the same medication can be prescribed at several dosages. The hospital pharmacy hands out these medications. Lionel, the pharmacist, is preparing his orders for the month: he wants the 5 most often prescribed medications, and the average length of their treatments.
textes.la durée moyenne de ses traitements, en: the average length of its treatments, in days, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les 5 premiers médicaments de: only the first 5 medications of this sort
textes.par nombre de prescriptions, du plus gra: by number of prescriptions, largest first, then by medication name
textes.Toutes les prescriptions d’un même médic: All the prescriptions of the same medication count together, whatever their dosage.
textes.Il faut une ligne par médicament, tous d: You need one row per medication, all dosages combined: count its prescriptions and average the lengths. Sort them, then keep only the first five; the name breaks ties.
textes.Quels patients ont consulté sans jamais: Which patients had consultations without ever being admitted?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Some patients only come for consultations; others are admitted to a department, for a finished or still ongoing stay. Consultations and stays are stored separately, each with its patient. Agnès, a manager at the admissions office, is studying patient pathways: she wants to know which ones came for a consultation without ever needing a bed.
textes.le prénom du patient (une ligne par pati: the patient’s first name (one row per patient)
textes.les patients qui ont au moins une consul: the patients with at least one consultation but no hospital stay, neither finished nor ongoing
textes.Pose deux questions sur chaque patient :: Ask two questions about each patient: do they have at least one consultation? Do they have at least one stay, finished or ongoing? Keep the ones who answer yes to the first and no to the second.
textes.Quelles consultations ont plus de 2 pres: Which consultations have more than 2 prescriptions?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. A consultation can lead to several medication prescriptions, or none. Lionel, the pharmacist, wants to examine the heaviest prescriptions: those where more than 2 medications add up and might interact with each other. He wants each consultation concerned, with its date and its number of prescriptions.
textes.seulement les consultations qui ont plus: only the consultations with more than 2 prescriptions (so at least 3)
textes.par nombre de prescriptions, du plus gra: by number of prescriptions, largest first, then by consultation ID
textes.Pour chaque consultation, compte ses pre: For each consultation, count its prescriptions. “More than 2” applies to that count and means at least 3: check it once the count is done.
textes.Quels patients ont consulté dans plusieu: Which patients had consultations in several departments?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. A consultation isn’t recorded with a department: it counts for the department of the doctor seen. The same patient can therefore go through several departments. Dr. Hamon coordinates patient pathways between departments. She’s finding those followed by at least 2 departments, so that their doctors properly share the information in their file.
textes.son nombre de services différents où il: their number of different departments where they had a consultation
textes.son nombre total de consultations, tous: their total number of consultations, all departments combined
textes.seulement les patients qui ont consulté: only the patients who had consultations in at least 2 different departments
textes.par nombre de services, du plus grand au: by number of departments, largest first, then by number of consultations, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Le service d’une consultation est celui: A consultation’s department is that of the doctor seen.
textes.Passe par le médecin de chaque consultat: Go through each consultation’s doctor to find its department. For each patient, count the different departments, without duplicates, and all their consultations; the threshold applies to the departments.
textes.Quels services ont des consultations san: Which departments have consultations without a diagnosis?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. Each consultation counts for the department of the doctor seen and must get a diagnosis; when it hasn’t been entered yet, its cell stays empty. Gérald, in the quality department, checks how the files are kept. He wants to know in which departments consultations are still without a diagnosis, and compare these gaps with the department’s whole activity.
textes.son nombre de consultations sans diagnos: its number of consultations without a diagnosis
textes.son nombre total de consultations, avec: its total number of consultations, with or without a diagnosis
textes.seulement les services qui ont au moins: only the departments with at least one consultation without a diagnosis
textes.par nombre de consultations sans diagnos: by number of consultations without a diagnosis, largest first, then by department name
textes.Une consultation sans diagnostic a une c: A consultation without a diagnosis has an empty diagnosis cell (NULL).
textes.Rattache chaque consultation à un servic: Attach each consultation to a department by going through its doctor. You need two counts side by side: the consultations without a diagnosis, counting 1 for an empty cell and 0 otherwise, and all the consultations. Leave out the departments without any gap.
textes.Quelles 5 villes comptent le plus de pat: Which 5 cities have the most patients?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Its patients come from several large French cities, and each one’s city is recorded in their file, even if they’ve never had a consultation. Ophélie, at the reception desk, wants to know where most of them come from: she’ll send her information brochures first to the 5 cities with the most patients.
textes.seulement les 5 premières villes de ce t: only the first 5 cities of this sort
textes.par nombre de patients, du plus grand au: by number of patients, largest first, then by city name
textes.Tous les patients enregistrés comptent,: Every registered patient counts, even those who have never had a consultation.
textes.Il faut une ligne par ville : compte les: You need one row per city: count the patients of each one. Then sort the cities and keep only the first five; the name breaks ties.
textes.Comment les médecins se classent-ils dan: How do the doctors rank within their department?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. Each department has its doctors, who see more or fewer patients in consultation, or none at all. For the annual reviews, Bertrand, the director, is helping each head of department see where their doctors stand. In each department, he wants to rank them by their number of consultations, including those who have none, counted as 0.
textes.son rang dans son service : 1 pour le pl: their rank in their department: 1 for the most consultations, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.par nom du service, puis par rang: by department name, then by rank
textes.Le classement recommence à 1 dans chaque: The ranking starts again at 1 in each department.
textes.Compte d’abord les consultations de chaq: First count each doctor’s consultations, keeping those who have none at 0. The rank is then given within each department: it starts again from 1 for each one.
textes.Quels patients consultent plus que la mo: Which patients have more consultations than the department average?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. A consultation belongs to the department of the doctor who sees the patient, and a patient can come back several times to the same department. Dr. Hamon wants to offer a lead doctor to the most closely followed patients. In each department, she’s looking for those who come for consultations more often than the average patient of that department.
textes.le nom du service (une ligne par patient: the name of the department (one row per patient and per department)
textes.son nombre de consultations dans ce serv: their number of consultations in this department
textes.la moyenne du service : le nombre moyen: the department average: the average number of consultations per patient who came to this department, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les patients dont ce nombre dé: only the patients whose number is strictly above the department average
textes.par nom du service, puis par nombre de c: by department name, then by number of consultations, largest first, then by patient last name
textes.Deux étapes : le nombre de consultations: Two steps: the number of consultations of each patient in each department, then the average of these numbers for each department. Link each patient to their department’s average to compare.
textes.Les consultations de Camille Moreau s’al: Are Camille Moreau’s consultations getting longer?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each consultation is recorded with its date and its duration, in minutes. The cardiologist who follows Camille Moreau is preparing her next appointment. She wants to see whether her patient’s consultations get longer or shorter from one time to the next: for each one, its duration, that of the consultation before and the difference between the two.
textes.la durée de la consultation précédente,: the duration of the previous consultation, an empty cell (NULL) for the first one

textes.Quel est le taux d’occupation de chaque: What is the occupancy rate of each department?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital. Each department has a fixed number of beds, from 4 in Neurology to 12 in Emergency. An admitted patient takes up a bed as long as their discharge date isn’t recorded. A department’s occupancy rate is 100 × its ongoing stays ÷ its number of beds. textes.Qui a consulté dans plus de services que: Who had consultations in more departments than average?
textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. textes.L’hôpital des Quatre-Vents est un hôpita: The Quatre-Vents Hospital is a university hospital with six departments. Each medication is prescribed during a consultation, and counts for the department of the doctor seen; a department can have no prescriptions.
